scores.note: Evidence is real but the framing is flattering sales-guy praise ('reads micro-signals'); the Kayla example is actually avoidance, not accurate reading, and 'energized by being correctly understood' is unsupported.
Correct and cleanly timed observation, but it is essentially his own stated 'pressure makes diamonds' creed with an avoidance label attached.
Well-evidenced but a standard therapy read of the provider archetype; largely a restatement of his self-proclaimed 'move in silence' identity.
Captures the hidden financial-spine pattern including the 'that's family / don't count it' reframe and the unstated cost.
Motion-as-safety is plausible and evidenced, but 'to prevent abandonment / make himself indispensable' is added motive the transcripts don't establish.
Catches the exact-number-for-vague-feeling substitution (sleep pivoting to posting schedule), though it misses the insomnia-as-discipline rebrand.
Gets the unglamorous, unpaid caretaking of isolated elderly customers as the real gift, opposite his closer identity; doesn't quite name the 'old people' specificity.
Sharp: names both the concealed subsidy and the tell that the exact dollar figures prove he has counted what he claims not to track.
Correctly links father, Big Mike and Kayla into one non-confrontation pattern; 'protecting their image' is a fair reading of the mechanism.
Good formal evidence (most sensory detail, 'I don't post about this'), but frames it as institutional advocacy rather than the actual elderly-tenderness pattern.
The cleanest contrast in the pool: hours of presence for strangers/elders, logistics-and-money for the people entangled with him.
Largely duplicates x005 and restates his own 'move in silence' ethos; the shame-protection motive is asserted, not shown.
Usefully resists the devout-believer decoy by showing the God-talk is post-hoc syntax over relentless control, though the 'disposable' inference overreaches.
Names the never-escalate pattern precisely and makes a checkable prediction about how he'll manage his nine reps.
Mostly the known 'quotes his mentors constantly' trait; the 'person becomes disposable' twist sits uneasily with his continued defense of Mike.
Overlaps heavily with x002 and with his own stated creed; the external-precision/internal-vagueness observation is the only part that adds anything.
